handle_new_user.body: DECLARE new_workspace_id UUID; BEGIN INSERT INTO public.workspaces (name, owner_id) VALUES (COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 'Meu Workspace'), NEW.id) RETURNING id INTO new_workspace_id; INSERT INTO public.workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id, role, email, name) VALUES (new_workspace_id, NEW.id, 'admin', NEW.email, NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'); RETURN NEW; END;

update_updated_at_column.body: BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;

is_user_locked_out.body: DECLARE failed_count INT; BEGIN SELECT count(*) INTO failed_count FROM public.auth_attempts WHERE email = target_email AND success = false AND created_at > (now() - interval '1 minute'); RETURN failed_count >= 5; END;

touch_chat_thread.body: BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN UPDATE public.chat_threads SET last_message_at = NEW.created_at, message_count = message_count + 1 WHERE id = NEW.thread_id; ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN UPDATE public.chat_threads SET message_count = GREATEST(0, message_count - 1) WHERE id = OLD.thread_id; END IF; RETURN NULL; END;

comments.table:rate_limit_logs: Rate limit events for abuse detection. Auto-cleanup recommended after 30 days.
comments.table:agent_routing_config: Maps external event sources (bitrix24, slack, gmail, ...) and event types to agents that should handle them.
comments.table:bitrix24_webhook_events: Append-only audit log of every Bitrix24 webhook received, with HMAC validation result and routing outcome.
comments.table:whatsapp_webhook_events: Append-only audit log of every WhatsApp webhook received, with provider, message id, signature validation result, and routing outcome. Reuses agent_routing_config with source=whatsapp.
comments.table:rate_limit_entries: Armazena timestamps de requests para rate limiting distribuído
comments.function:check_rate_limit: Verifica e registra rate limit de forma atômica
comments.function:cleanup_rate_limit_entries: Remove entradas expiradas do rate limiter
comments.function:get_slo_summary: Returns SLO summary for the authenticated user over a window in hours.
comments.column:workspace_members.email: PII: visible only to self and workspace admins. Use workspace_members_safe view.
comments.column:oncall_schedule.user_email: PII: visible only to self and workspace admins. Use oncall_schedule_safe view.
comments.column:agent_memories_v2.memory_tier: Autograph tier: core/active/warm/cold/archive (recalc diário via recompute_memory_tier)
comments.column:notification_templates.workspace_: ETAPA 4: NULL = template global do sistema, UUID = custom do workspace
comments.column:automation_templates.workspace_id: ETAPA 4: NULL = template global do marketplace, UUID = custom do workspace
comments.column:connector_registry.workspace_id: ETAPA 4: NULL = global do marketplace, UUID = custom do workspace
comments.column:skill_registry.workspace_id: ETAPA 5: NULL = global do marketplace, UUID = custom do workspace
comments.column:dr_drills.allowed_target_tables: ETAPA 8: whitelist explícita de tabelas permitidas no drill
comments.column:api_keys.key_method: ETAPA 9: método de hash — sha256=legado (requer re-key), bcrypt=ativo
comments.column:deploy_connections.key_method: ETAPA 9: método de hash — sha256=legado, bcrypt=ativo
comments.column:audit_log.workspace_id: ETAPA 10: denormalizado do workspace do actor para filtragem RLS
comments.column:chunks.embedding_model: Modelo que gerou o embedding. Comparar vetores de modelos distintos produz resultado sem significado; match_documents filtra por este campo.
comments.function:match_documents: Busca por similaridade em chunks. SECURITY INVOKER: o isolamento por workspace vem da RLS de chunks/documents/collections.
comments.column:skill_registry.curated_by: Último administrador que editou esta skill pública (curadoria).
comments.table:chat_threads: Conversas do AgentTalk. Um agente pode ter N threads por usuário.
comments.column:chat_messages.parent_id: Mensagem anterior no caminho. Múltiplos filhos = ramificação da conversa.
comments.column:skill_registry.description_source: Procedencia da descricao: humano (escrita/curada por pessoa), repositorio (extraida do fonte), ia (gerada por LLM). NULL = desconhecida.
comments.column:skill_reclassification_reviews.co: Limiar de confianca exigido pelo curador no momento da proposta. Sem ele, uma proposta de 0.60 aprovada ontem e indistinguivel de uma rejeitada hoje sob limiar 0.80.
comments.column:skill_registry.department_confide: Confianca [0,1] da classificacao departamental; herdada do candidato na promocao.
comments.column:skill_registry.department_source: Procedencia da classificacao: unknown | heuristic | llm | human | import.
comments.column:skill_registry.is_meta_collection: true quando o item e uma coletanea (awesome-list, curso, roadmap, livro de links) e nao uma skill instalavel. Espelha isMetaRepository() do harvester. Excluido da fila de revisao departamental e da vitrine publica.

match_chunks.returns:
TABLE (
  id UUID,
  document_id UUID,
  content TEXT,
  chunk_index INT,
  metadata JSONB,
  similarity FLOAT
)
match_chunks.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.content, c.chunk_index, c.metadata, 1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity FROM public.chunks c JOIN public.documents d ON d.id = c.document_id JOIN public.collections col ON col.id = d.collection_id WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_status = 'done' AND (filter_kb_id IS NULL OR col.knowledge_base_id = filter_kb_id) AND 1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold ORDER BY c.embedding <=> query_embedding LIMIT match_count; END;

match_memories.returns:
TABLE (
  id UUID,
  memory_type TEXT,
  content TEXT,
  source TEXT,
  similarity FLOAT
)
match_memories.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT m.id, m.memory_type, m.content, m.source, 1 - (m.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity FROM public.agent_memories m WHERE m.agent_id = p_agent_id AND m.embedding IS NOT NULL AND (m.expires_at IS NULL OR m.expires_at > now()) AND 1 - (m.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold ORDER BY m.embedding <=> query_embedding LIMIT match_count; END;

# ⚡ Nexus Agents Studio

> **Plataforma Operacional de Inteligência Artificial** para criação, treinamento, deploy e gestão de agentes IA de alto desempenho.

**O que nos diferencia:** Nenhum concorrente (Dify, n8n, CrewAI, StackAI, Vellum) combina TODOS estes recursos em uma plataforma única:

- 🔮 **Oráculo** — Multi-LLM Council Engine (conselho de múltiplas IAs deliberando)
- 🧠 **Super Cérebro** — Enterprise Memory Layer com Knowledge Graph temporal
- 🗄️ **DataHub** — Cross-database intelligence (5 bancos, 340+ tabelas, 920K+ registros)
- ⚡ **Agent Builder** — 15 tabs de configuração profunda com score de prontidão
- 🔀 **Workflow Canvas** — Editor visual drag-and-drop com 12 tipos de nó
- 🌐 **MCP + A2A** — Interoperabilidade com 5.800+ servidores e agentes externos

## Stack

```
React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/UI + Supabase + Zustand
```

## Arquitetura

```
├── src/
│   ├── components/        # UI components (agent-builder, rbac, workflows, super-cerebro)
│   ├── services/          # 13 domain services (agents, workflows, oracle, cerebro, ...)
│   ├── stores/            # 7 Zustand stores
│   ├── hooks/             # Custom hooks (useRBAC, useBillingData, useTracesData, useI18n)
│   ├── lib/mcp/           # MCP Client + Registry
│   ├── i18n/              # Internationalization (pt-BR, en-US)
│   └── pages/             # 30+ pages
├── supabase/
│   ├── functions/         # 24 Edge Functions + _shared modules
│   │   ├── _shared/       # rate-limiter, cors, auth, validation
│   │   ├── llm-gateway/   # Multi-provider LLM gateway (771 lines)
│   │   ├── smolagent-runtime/  # Autonomous ReAct agent (604 lines)
│   │   ├── oracle-council/    # Multi-LLM deliberation
│   │   ├── oracle-research/   # Deep Research iterativo
│   │   ├── datahub-mcp-server/ # DataHub exposed as MCP server
│   │   ├── a2a-server/       # Agent-to-Agent Protocol
│   │   ├── guardrails-engine/ # 4-layer defense-in-depth
│   │   └── ...
│   └── migrations/        # 42 SQL migrations (38 original + 4 new)
└── .github/workflows/     # CI/CD (lint → typecheck → test → build)
```

## Segurança

- 🔒 CORS whitelist (zero wildcard) em todas as 24 Edge Functions
- 🛡️ Rate limiting com 7 presets (standard, llm, heavy, auth, webhook, datahub, oracle)
- 👥 RBAC com 5 roles e 31 permissões
- 🔐 Guardrails 4 camadas (prompt injection, PII, toxicidade, vazamento de secrets)
- 🔑 API keys com hash SHA-256

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/adm01-debug/Fator_X_V2.git
cd Fator_X_V2
npm install
npm run dev
```
